ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites will be enforced. This course will open to all Gies Business Administration majors on Monday, November 18, 2019 and to Gies Finance majors and Informatics Minors on Monday, November 25, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 24, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course.
